profiles.biography: W.L. Whaley is a music/general-effect adjudicator and clinician and the former Director of Bands at Pomona High School in Arvada, Colorado (1987-2007). He is Executive Director of AdvantEdge Tours/Dramart Productions and Chief Judge for the Colorado Bandmasters Association, and works as a clinician, consultant, designer, and adjudicator across the United States, including the General Effect and Music captions for Drum Corps International. He was inducted into the Colorado Bandmasters Association Hall of Fame (2004) and named Phi Beta Mu Kappa Chapter Most Outstanding Bandmaster (2007), and is a Conn-Selmer clinician.

profiles.biography: Christine Clayton Fisher is a color guard and visual adjudicator who performed in the color guard at the University of Southern California and with the Sacramento Freelancers drum and bugle corps, then spent 15 years teaching high school and college color guard in the Los Angeles area (including Granada Hills Charter and USC). Based in Portland, Oregon, she judges visual captions for marching band circuits in the fall and movement, general effect, and visual for guard and percussion in the winter. She has served as Director of Education for the Winter Guard Association of Southern California and Judges Liaison for the Southeastern Color Guard Circuit, holds a B.S. in Business Management and an MBA from the University of Phoenix, and is Director of Human Resources for BD Performing Arts.

profiles.biography: Dan Bryan is a percussion adjudicator, clinician, and educator who is Chair of Secondary Music for Modesto City Schools and Director of Instrumental Music at Joseph Gregori High School in Modesto, California. A former member of the DCI finalist Sacramento Freelancers (1989, 1992), where he performed in both the horn line and front ensemble, he is an eight-time Winter Guard International World Championship medal winner and four-time WGI finalist as an instructor/composer, and adjudicates for Drum Corps International and the Western Band Association.

facts.fact: Modesto City Schools Secondary Music Chair / Gregori HS Dir of Instrumental Music; Sacramento Freelancers alum; 8x WGI medalist; DCI percussion judge

profiles.biography: Jeff Mills is a brass/music adjudicator rostered with Drum Corps International in the music and effect captions. A native of San Jose, California, he earned a Bachelor of Arts in Education from the University of North Florida and a Master of Music from Valdosta State University, and his teaching experience spans middle school, high school, and college band, drum corps, applied trumpet, and conducting. He works as a freelance trumpeter in north and central Florida.

facts.fact: DCI rostered music/effect judge; San Jose native; UNF + Valdosta State degrees; Florida freelance trumpeter

profiles.biography: Monte Mast is a music adjudicator and arts administrator who recently retired as Executive Director of The Cavaliers AP&E (CAPE), the parent organization of the seven-time DCI champion Cavaliers. He judged for DCI for nearly 20 years across six championship panels and has judged contests in 40 states, including state championships in 12, plus a decade judging indoor guards for the Texas Color Guard Circuit. He spent three years on the Phantom Regiment brass instructional staff, including their first DCI title in 1996, and was named the Texas Music Administrators Conference 2018 Administrator of the Year. He resides in Lafayette, Oregon.

facts.fact: Retired Cavaliers CAPE Exec Director; DCI judge ~20 yrs / 6 championship panels; Phantom Regiment brass staff (1996 title); TX Music Administrators 2018 Administrator of the Year

profiles.biography: Michael Brady Tarr is a visual adjudicator with over thirty years of experience consulting, designing, teaching, and leading visual programs for top drum corps including the Boston Crusaders, Cavaliers, Santa Clara Vanguard, Bluecoats, and Glassmen. He joined the Bluecoats as a visual instructor in 2001 and became their visual coordinator, directing the corps' overall visual package. In high demand as an adjudicator and clinician worldwide, he has served in the Visual Proficiency and General Effect captions at DCI World Championships.

profiles.biography: Mark Teal is a percussion adjudicator, arranger, and clinician who has judged for Drum Corps International since 2015. He earned a Bachelor's in Music Education from the University of North Texas in 2002 and was named College Keyboard World Champion at the 2000 PAS Convention. He performed four years in the front ensemble of the Carolina Crown drum and bugle corps (1996, 1998-2000) and served on staff with Carolina Crown (2001, 2004), the Phantom Regiment (2005-2010), and the Santa Clara Vanguard (2011) as a front-ensemble technician, and writes for top bands nationwide.

facts.fact: DCI judge since 2015; UNT BME; 2000 PAS College Keyboard World Champion; Carolina Crown/Phantom Regiment/SCV front ensemble

profiles.biography: Tim Pierce is a visual adjudicator, designer, and educator and an alumnus of the Cavaliers drum and bugle corps. He holds a Bachelor's in Music Education from the University of Southern Mississippi and a Master of Fine Arts from Mississippi College, and began his career as a band director. He has served on adjudication panels for Bands of America, Drum Corps International, and many state and local associations, and adjudicated WGI's Movement and Design Analysis captions while serving on the WGI Task Force as Movement Caption Facilitator. He has been Program Consultant for Music City Drum Corps, Visual Coordinator for the Blue Knights, and Program Coordinator for the WGI Independent World Class finalist Cypress Independent color guard.

profiles.biography: Richard Saucedo is an internationally renowned composer, arranger, adjudicator, conductor, and clinician, and a member of the Drum Corps International Hall of Fame (2022). He spent 31 years as director of bands at Carmel High School in Indiana, where the Marching Greyhounds finished in the top ten of BOA Grand Nationals for 17 years and were BOA Champions in 2005 and 2012. He began judging drum corps in the mid-1990s, consulted on the Cavaliers' design and instructional teams beginning in 1999 and served as their arranger/composer through 2008, and also wrote for the Spirit of Atlanta and Blue Stars while continuing to judge on the DCI Tour and at World Championships. He was inducted into the Music for All Hall of Fame (2015) and named Indiana Bandmasters' Bandmaster of the Year (1998-99) and IMEA Outstanding Music Educator (2010).
